title: 日式土豆炖肉
body:
## 食材

- 土豆：切大块
- 洋葱：顺纹切丝
- 牛小排或薄切牛肉
- 糖、酱油、清酒或味醂、食用油、水

## 做法

### 1. 炒香洋葱

热锅加少量油，放入洋葱，炒至边缘微焦、呈咖啡色。

### 2. 煸炒牛肉

加入牛肉，炒至表面无红色、油脂释出，再加糖炒匀。

### 3. 加入土豆

放入土豆，倒入酱油、清酒或味醂等调味液，加水至与食材齐平。

### 4. 加盖慢炖

用剪成锅口大小的烘焙纸或铝箔纸作落盖，盖在食材上。中小火炖约 25 分钟。

### 5. 收汁出锅

炖至牛肉和土豆软烂、汤汁收浓。用筷子轻戳土豆，确认熟透后出锅。

## 小贴士

- 土豆切大块，炖煮后更容易保持形状。
- 落盖能帮助汤汁循环，使食材均匀入味。
- 可搭配米饭、腌菜或炒青菜。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1UfWOyM6rNc)
description: 洋葱炒出甜味，牛肉与土豆慢炖入味。
descriptionEn: Sweet onions, tender beef and chunky potatoes simmered in a savory sauce.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Potatoes, cut into large chunks
- Onion, sliced along the grain
- Beef short rib or thinly sliced beef
- Sugar, soy sauce, sake or mirin, cooking oil and water

## Method

### 1. Brown the onion

Heat a little oil in a pan. Add the onion and cook until the edges are lightly browned.

### 2. Cook the beef

Add the beef and stir-fry until no red remains on the surface and some fat has rendered. Add sugar and stir to combine.

### 3. Add the potatoes

Add the potatoes, soy sauce and sake or mirin. Pour in water until it is level with the ingredients.

### 4. Simmer under a drop lid

Cut a piece of baking paper or foil to fit the pan and lay it directly over the ingredients as a drop lid. Simmer over medium-low heat for about 25 minutes.

### 5. Reduce and serve

Cook until the beef and potatoes are tender and the sauce has reduced. Pierce a potato with chopsticks to check that it is cooked through, then serve.

## Tips

- Large potato chunks hold their shape better during simmering.
- A drop lid helps the sauce circulate and season the ingredients evenly.
- Serve with rice, pickles or stir-fried greens.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1UfWOyM6rNc)

title: 阿见版蛋炒饭
body:
## 食材

- 米饭：提前搅散
- 鸡蛋 3 个：蛋黄、蛋白分开
- 火腿肠、黄瓜、培根：切丁，黄瓜去瓤
- 玉米粒、甜豆、小葱
- 盐、白胡椒粉、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理米饭

将米饭搅散。蛋黄打散后倒入米饭，拌至饭粒均匀裹上蛋液；蛋白单独搅散备用。

### 2. 准备配料

火腿肠、黄瓜、培根切丁，小葱切葱花。玉米粒和甜豆放入加盐、加油的沸水中，焯至浮起后捞出。

### 3. 煸炒辅料

锅中加油，放入火腿肠和玉米粒炒香，盛出备用。

### 4. 炒蛋白

锅中留底油，小火炒蛋白至凝固，用锅铲分成小块。

### 5. 炒散米饭

加入拌好蛋黄的米饭，大火翻炒，炒至饭粒干爽、不粘锅。

### 6. 合炒调味

加入火腿肠、黄瓜、玉米、甜豆和培根丁，翻炒均匀。加少量盐和白胡椒粉，撒葱花炒匀后出锅。

## 小贴士

- 米饭煮得稍硬一些，炒时更容易粒粒分明。
- 配料较多，调味宜清淡。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VCELAeG3lyI)
description: 蛋黄裹饭、蛋白单炒，搭配多种蔬菜和肉类配料。
descriptionEn: Yolk-coated rice and separately cooked egg whites with vegetables, ham sausage and bacon.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Rice, loosened in advance
- 3 eggs, yolks and whites separated
- Ham sausage, cucumber and bacon, diced; remove the cucumber seeds
- Corn kernels, sweet peas and scallions
- Salt, white pepper and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the rice and eggs

Loosen the rice. Beat the yolks, then mix them into the rice until the grains are evenly coated. Beat the whites separately and set aside.

### 2. Prepare the other ingredients

Dice the ham sausage, cucumber and bacon. Chop the scallions. Blanch the corn and sweet peas in boiling water with salt and oil until they float, then drain.

### 3. Stir-fry the ham and corn

Heat oil in a pan. Stir-fry the ham sausage and corn until fragrant, then remove.

### 4. Cook the egg whites

Leave a little oil in the pan. Cook the egg whites over low heat until set, breaking them into small pieces.

### 5. Fry the rice

Add the yolk-coated rice and stir-fry over high heat until the grains are dry, separate and no longer stick to the pan.

### 6. Combine and season

Add the ham sausage, cucumber, corn, peas and bacon. Stir-fry together, season lightly with salt and white pepper, then add scallions and toss before serving.

## Tips

- Rice cooked slightly firm separates more easily when fried.
- Keep the seasoning light to suit the variety of ingredients.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VCELAeG3lyI)

title: 虾仁蛋炒饭
body:
## 食材

- 带壳虾：虾肉、虾壳分开处理
- 冷米饭、鸡蛋、葱
- 盐、食用油、水

## 做法

### 1. 熬虾汤

虾壳入锅炒至熟透、香味释出，压碎后加适量水煮出虾汤，过滤备用。虾油留作炒制使用。

### 2. 炒虾

锅中加油，放入虾肉，加少量水和虾油煎炒，炒出香气。也可省略单独炒虾，改为与鸡蛋一起炒。

### 3. 炒蛋炒饭

另起锅加少量虾油，放葱炒香，再加入鸡蛋和冷米饭，用锅铲炒散。

### 4. 分次加汤

少量、多次加入虾汤，边加边炒，让饭粒吸收汤汁，避免一次倒入过多。

### 5. 调味出锅

加入盐和虾汁，炒至饭粒干爽。最后补少量虾油，炒匀出锅。

## 小贴士

- 虾汤要分次加入，避免米饭变湿、结团。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SuekA2ucsU)
description: 用虾壳熬出虾汤，分次加入米饭，突出鲜虾风味。
descriptionEn: Shrimp-shell broth is added a little at a time for richly flavored rice.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Shell-on shrimp; separate the meat and shells
- Cold cooked rice, eggs and scallions
- Salt, cooking oil and water

## Method

### 1. Make the shrimp broth

Stir-fry the shrimp shells until fully cooked and fragrant. Crush them, add water and simmer to make a broth, then strain. Reserve the shrimp oil for frying.

### 2. Cook the shrimp

Heat oil in a pan. Add the shrimp meat with a little water and shrimp oil, and stir-fry until fragrant. Alternatively, skip this separate step and cook the shrimp with the eggs.

### 3. Fry the eggs and rice

In another pan, heat a little shrimp oil. Fry the scallions, then add the eggs and cold rice. Break up the rice with a spatula.

### 4. Add broth gradually

Add the shrimp broth in small additions, stir-frying as you go so the rice absorbs the liquid. Do not pour in too much at once.

### 5. Season and serve

Add salt and shrimp juices. Continue stir-frying until the grains are dry. Finish with a little shrimp oil, toss and serve.

## Tips

- Add the shrimp broth gradually to avoid wet, clumped rice.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SuekA2ucsU)

title: 鸡蛋炒米粉
body:
## 食材

- 米粉（原做法使用阿里加香米粉）
- 鸡蛋 1 个
- 豆芽、葱白、葱叶、葱头
- 盐、生抽、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 焯煮米粉

锅中水烧开，加少量油和盐，放入米粉搅散。煮约 2 分钟，水再次沸腾时捞出。

### 2. 焖发米粉

米粉控水后放入盆中，加盖焖 3 分钟，翻面后再焖 3 分钟。

### 3. 准备配料

豆芽洗净沥干，葱切段，葱头切开。鸡蛋加适量盐打散。

### 4. 炒鸡蛋

热锅加油，倒入蛋液，炒至刚成形后盛出。

### 5. 炒香米粉

原锅加油，下米粉稍煎并翻面，再用筷子抖散，炒出米香和微微焦香。

### 6. 合炒调味

依次加入鸡蛋、葱白和豆芽，加生抽炒匀。最后加入葱叶，关火拌匀出锅。

## 小贴士

- 焖发后的米粉应干爽、有弹性，不湿黏。
- 炒米粉时配合使用锅铲和筷子，更容易抖散。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uw4tSDT-ElU)
description: 先焖发再炒制，让米粉干爽有弹性。
descriptionEn: Rest the briefly boiled noodles under a lid, then stir-fry for a dry, springy texture.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Rice vermicelli; the original method uses Alijia fragrant rice vermicelli
- 1 egg
- Bean sprouts, scallion whites and greens, and scallion bulbs
- Salt, light soy sauce and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Briefly boil the noodles

Bring water to a boil with a little oil and salt. Add the rice vermicelli and loosen it. Cook for about 2 minutes; drain when the water returns to a boil.

### 2. Rest under a lid

Drain the noodles into a bowl. Cover for 3 minutes, turn them over, then cover for another 3 minutes.

### 3. Prepare the other ingredients

Wash and drain the bean sprouts. Cut the scallions into lengths and split the scallion bulbs. Beat the egg with salt.

### 4. Cook the egg

Heat oil in a pan. Add the egg and cook until just set, then remove.

### 5. Fry the noodles

Add oil to the same pan. Spread out the noodles, let them fry briefly, then turn them over. Use chopsticks to loosen them and fry until fragrant and lightly toasted.

### 6. Combine and season

Add the egg, scallion whites and bean sprouts in that order. Season with light soy sauce. Add the scallion greens, turn off the heat and toss before serving.

## Tips

- After resting, the noodles should be springy and relatively dry, rather than wet and sticky.
- Use a spatula together with chopsticks to loosen the noodles.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uw4tSDT-ElU)

title: 烧椒皮蛋炒饭
body:
## 食材

- 绿辣椒 2 根、糯米椒 3 根
- 皮蛋、鸡蛋、米饭、葱花
- 花椒油、酱油或酱油膏、白胡椒粉、香油
- 盐、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 烤辣椒

将辣椒烤至表皮焦黑，放入碗中，盖保鲜膜焖至表皮变软，再剥皮。可留少许焦皮增加香气。

### 2. 拌皮蛋酱

皮蛋去壳压碎，与辣椒、葱花、花椒油、酱油、白胡椒粉和香油拌匀。

### 3. 炒蛋炒饭

锅烧热后加油，打入鸡蛋，先让蛋液受热出香，再加入米饭炒散、炒干水分。

### 4. 加入酱料

放入葱花，再加约 1 匙皮蛋辣椒酱，翻炒均匀。

### 5. 调味出锅

根据口味补少量酱油、盐和白胡椒粉，炒匀出锅。

## 小贴士

- 皮蛋酱也可用于拌面或作蘸酱。
- 想增加皮蛋风味，可在装盘后搭配少量皮蛋酱。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kItDG3GaLSk)
titleEn: Charred pepper and century egg fried rice
description: 焦香辣椒拌入皮蛋酱，再与蛋炒饭合炒。
descriptionEn: Charred green peppers and century egg make a fragrant fried-rice relish.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 2 green chilies and 3 nuomijiao peppers (mild green peppers)
- Century eggs, eggs, cooked rice and chopped scallions
- Sichuan pepper oil, soy sauce or thick soy sauce, white pepper and sesame oil
- Salt and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Char the peppers

Roast the peppers until the skins are blackened. Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let the skins soften, then peel. Leave a little charred skin for flavor if desired.

### 2. Make the century-egg relish

Peel and crush the century eggs. Mix with the peppers, scallions, Sichuan pepper oil, soy sauce, white pepper and sesame oil.

### 3. Fry the eggs and rice

Heat the pan, then add oil and crack in the eggs. Let them cook briefly to develop aroma before adding the rice. Break up the rice and fry off excess moisture.

### 4. Add the relish

Add scallions and about 1 spoonful of the century-egg relish. Stir-fry to combine.

### 5. Adjust the seasoning

Add a little soy sauce, salt and white pepper to taste. Toss and serve.

## Tips

- The relish also works with noodles or as a dipping sauce.
- For a stronger century-egg flavor, serve a little extra relish alongside the rice.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kItDG3GaLSk)

title: 红烧茄子
body:
## 食材

- 紫皮茄子数根、瘦肉适量
- 青龙椒、蒜
- 盐、白醋、蒜蓉鲜调味料、胡椒粉、白糖
- 老抽、生抽、食用油
- 玉米淀粉、水

## 做法

### 1. 处理茄子

茄子用淡盐水洗净，去蒂切滚刀块。加盐和白醋拌匀，腌 10 分钟，再洗去盐分，充分挤干水分。

### 2. 准备配料

瘦肉剁成肉末，青椒切斜片，蒜拍碎切末。

### 3. 调料汁

将盐、蒜蓉鲜、胡椒粉、白糖、老抽、生抽和食用油拌匀。另用玉米淀粉和水调成水淀粉。

### 4. 炒软茄子

热锅加油，放入茄子，炒软、炒至变色后盛出。

### 5. 炒香肉末

锅留底油，放入肉末和蒜末，炒至肉末变色、香味释出。

### 6. 合炒收汁

加入青椒和料汁，大火烧开，放回茄子炒匀。倒入水淀粉，炒至汤汁包裹茄子后出锅。

## 小贴士

- 茄子腌后尽量挤干水分，炒制时更容易入味。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x6Uit9bmN-g)
description: 茄子先腌后炒，配肉末和酱汁烧至软嫩入味。
descriptionEn: Salted eggplant is stir-fried with minced meat and a savory sauce.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Several purple eggplants and some lean meat
- Qinglong green peppers and garlic
- Salt, white vinegar, Suanrongxian garlic seasoning, pepper and sugar
- Dark soy sauce, light soy sauce and cooking oil
- Cornstarch and water

## Method

### 1. Prepare the eggplant

Wash the eggplant in lightly salted water. Remove the stems and cut into rolling-cut chunks. Mix with salt and white vinegar, leave for 10 minutes, rinse off the salt and squeeze out as much water as possible.

### 2. Prepare the other ingredients

Mince the meat. Slice the green peppers diagonally and crush and mince the garlic.

### 3. Mix the sauce

Combine salt, garlic seasoning, pepper, sugar, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce and oil. Separately mix cornstarch with water to make a slurry.

### 4. Cook the eggplant

Heat oil in a pan. Stir-fry the eggplant until softened and changed in color, then remove.

### 5. Cook the meat

Leave a little oil in the pan. Add the minced meat and garlic and stir-fry until the meat changes color and becomes fragrant.

### 6. Combine and thicken

Add the peppers and sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Return the eggplant and toss. Add the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce coats the eggplant, then serve.

## Tips

- Squeeze the salted eggplant thoroughly before cooking so it takes up the sauce more readily.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x6Uit9bmN-g)

title: 星洲炒米粉
body:
## 食材

- 排米粉 150 克、叉烧约 100 克
- 虾、鸡蛋 2 个、豆芽约 100 克
- 韭黄 30～50 克、青红椒、洋葱、葱白、葱叶
- 油咖喱 20 克、姜黄粉 5 克、桂林辣椒酱 10 克
- 水或料酒 15 克（调酱用）
- 盐、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理米粉

水中加盐 3～5 克、油 8～10 克，放入米粉，煮 1～2 分钟至略软后捞出，加盖利用余温焖软。

### 2. 准备配料

盐渍虾焯水约 10 秒。叉烧焯水去除表面糖分，切条或片。青红椒和洋葱切条，葱和韭黄切段，鸡蛋打散。

### 3. 调咖喱酱

油咖喱、姜黄粉和桂林辣椒酱拌匀；如太稠，加水或料酒 15 克调至可流动。

### 4. 分别炒配料

锅中加约 10 克油，炒熟鸡蛋后盛出。虾仁大火炒约半分钟，盛出。再加约 5 克油，炒香洋葱，加入青红椒、盐 2 克和豆芽，炒至略软后盛出摊凉。

### 5. 炒香米粉

锅中加油 5～6 克，放入米粉铺平稍煎，翻面炒至略焦、干香。米粉过长时可用锅铲切断。

### 6. 拌酱合炒

关火，加入咖喱酱拌匀，再开火炒香。加入葱头和炒好的配料，包括叉烧，快速翻炒。

### 7. 收尾出锅

加入葱段和韭黄，利用余温炒熟后装盘。

## 小贴士

- 米粉不必在焯煮时完全煮熟。
- 锅底发白、冒烟时转小火，避免炒焦。
- 叉烧先焯水，有助于减少炒制时粘锅。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wgZPifWWNmc)
description: 咖喱酱拌匀米粉，搭配虾仁、叉烧和蔬菜。
descriptionEn: Curry-seasoned rice noodles with shrimp, char siu and vegetables.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 150 g rice vermicelli and about 100 g char siu pork
- Shrimp, 2 eggs and about 100 g bean sprouts
- 30–50 g yellow garlic chives, green and red peppers, onion, scallion whites and greens
- 20 g oil-based curry paste, 5 g turmeric and 10 g Guilin chili sauce
- 15 g water or cooking wine, for loosening the sauce
- Salt and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the noodles

Add 3–5 g salt and 8–10 g oil to boiling water. Add the noodles and cook for 1–2 minutes until slightly softened. Drain and cover so residual heat softens them further.

### 2. Prepare the other ingredients

Blanch the salted shrimp for about 10 seconds. Blanch the char siu to remove surface sugar, then slice. Cut the peppers and onion into strips, cut the scallions and chives into lengths, and beat the eggs.

### 3. Mix the curry sauce

Mix the curry paste, turmeric and Guilin chili sauce. If too thick, add 15 g water or cooking wine until it flows.

### 4. Cook the additions separately

Heat about 10 g oil and scramble the eggs, then remove. Stir-fry the shrimp over high heat for about half a minute and remove. Add about 5 g oil, fry the onion, then add the peppers, 2 g salt and bean sprouts. Fry until slightly softened, then spread out to cool.

### 5. Fry the noodles

Heat 5–6 g oil. Spread out the noodles, let them fry briefly, then turn them and fry until dry, fragrant and lightly toasted. Cut very long strands with a spatula if needed.

### 6. Add the sauce and other ingredients

Turn off the heat and mix in the curry sauce. Turn the heat back on and fry until fragrant. Add the scallion bulbs and cooked additions, including the char siu, and toss quickly.

### 7. Finish and serve

Add the scallion lengths and yellow garlic chives. Let residual heat cook them, then serve.

## Tips

- The noodles do not need to be fully cooked during the initial boiling.
- Lower the heat if the pan starts to turn white and smoke, to avoid burning the noodles.
- Blanching the char siu first helps prevent its sugary surface from sticking.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wgZPifWWNmc)

title: 海鲜粉丝煲
body:
## 食材

- 粉丝、大虾
- 鸡蛋 1 个、蒜末、葱花
- 青椒丝、胡萝卜丝等配菜
- 老抽 1/3 勺、生抽 4 勺（分两次使用）
- 蚝油 1 勺、白胡椒粉适量、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理粉丝

粉丝用开水泡 20 秒，捞出后立即放冷水中泡 10 分钟。沥干、剪段，加老抽 1/3 勺和生抽 2 勺拌匀。

### 2. 准备虾和碗汁

大虾去头、去壳，保留虾尾，开背去虾线。虾头留用。生抽 2 勺、蚝油 1 勺和白胡椒粉拌成碗汁。

### 3. 煎虾油

热锅加油，小火煎虾头至金黄酥脆，捞出虾头，保留虾油。

### 4. 炒蛋和配菜

虾油中加入蒜末，打入鸡蛋炒散，再下青椒丝、胡萝卜丝等配菜，炒至八成熟。

### 5. 合炒粉丝和虾

放入粉丝，用筷子炒拌约 1 分钟，加入虾肉。倒入碗汁，快速翻炒，出锅前撒葱花。

### 6. 装入砂锅

将炒好的粉丝装入提前预热的砂锅，即可上桌。

## 小贴士

- 粉丝先短泡、再过冷水，有助于保持弹性。
- 粉丝入锅后及时抖散，避免结块。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k5ed5oJ7g4w)
description: 虾头煎出虾油，粉丝吸足鲜味后装入热砂锅。
descriptionEn: Glass noodles absorb shrimp-head oil before serving in a hot clay pot.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Glass noodles and large shrimp
- 1 egg, minced garlic and chopped scallions
- Shredded green pepper, carrot or similar vegetables
- 1/3 spoonful dark soy sauce and 4 spoonfuls light soy sauce, divided
- 1 spoonful oyster sauce, white pepper to taste and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the glass noodles

Soak the noodles in boiling water for 20 seconds, then immediately transfer to cold water for 10 minutes. Drain and cut into shorter lengths. Mix with 1/3 spoonful dark soy sauce and 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce.

### 2. Prepare the shrimp and sauce

Remove the shrimp heads and shells, keeping the tails. Slit the backs and remove the veins. Reserve the heads. Mix 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce, 1 spoonful oyster sauce and white pepper for the sauce.

### 3. Make the shrimp oil

Heat oil in a pan. Fry the shrimp heads over low heat until golden and crisp, then remove them, leaving the flavored oil.

### 4. Cook the egg and vegetables

Add garlic to the shrimp oil. Crack in the egg and scramble it. Add the shredded vegetables and cook until nearly cooked.

### 5. Combine noodles and shrimp

Add the noodles and toss with chopsticks for about 1 minute, then add the shrimp meat. Pour in the sauce and stir-fry quickly. Add scallions just before serving.

### 6. Transfer to the clay pot

Transfer the noodles to a preheated clay pot and serve.

## Tips

- Brief hot soaking followed by cold water helps the glass noodles stay springy.
- Loosen the noodles promptly in the pan to prevent clumping.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k5ed5oJ7g4w)

title: 茄子炒鸡蛋
body:
## 食材

- 茄子 2 根、鸡蛋 2 个
- 蒜、姜、小米辣、青椒、番茄
- 盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、蚝油、生抽
- 玉米淀粉、水、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理茄子

茄子去蒂，切约 1 厘米的小方块，加盐抓匀，腌 20 分钟。冲洗 2 遍，充分沥干。

### 2. 准备配料和料汁

蒜姜切末，小米辣切圈，青椒和番茄切小块。盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、蚝油、生抽、玉米淀粉和水拌成料汁。

### 3. 炒鸡蛋

鸡蛋加胡椒粉，顺一个方向搅匀。热锅加少量油，小火煎炒成块后盛出。

### 4. 炒熟茄子

另加少量油，放入茄子，慢火煎炒至熟，盛出备用。

### 5. 炒香配菜

锅中加油，爆香蒜末、姜末和小米辣，放入番茄炒出汁，再加青椒快速翻炒。

### 6. 合炒出锅

鸡蛋和茄子回锅，倒入料汁，大火炒匀，待酱汁均匀裹住食材后出锅。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gw22Gjk4LEI)
description: 茄子和鸡蛋分别煎炒，再与番茄、青椒合炒。
descriptionEn: Eggplant and eggs are cooked separately, then combined with tomato and pepper.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 2 eggplants and 2 eggs
- Garlic, ginger, small hot chilies, green pepper and tomato
- Salt, chicken bouillon seasoning, pepper, oyster sauce and light soy sauce
- Cornstarch, water and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the eggplant

Remove the stems and cut the eggplant into cubes about 1 cm wide. Rub with salt and leave for 20 minutes. Rinse 2 times and drain thoroughly.

### 2. Prepare the additions and sauce

Mince the garlic and ginger, slice the chilies into rings, and dice the pepper and tomato. Mix salt, chicken seasoning, pepper, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, cornstarch and water into a sauce.

### 3. Cook the eggs

Beat the eggs with pepper, stirring in one direction. Heat a little oil and cook the eggs over low heat until they form pieces, then remove.

### 4. Cook the eggplant

Add a little oil and slowly pan-fry and stir-fry the eggplant until cooked. Remove and set aside.

### 5. Cook the vegetables

Add oil and fry the garlic, ginger and chilies until fragrant. Add the tomato and cook until juicy, then add the green pepper and stir-fry quickly.

### 6. Combine and serve

Return the eggs and eggplant. Add the sauce and stir-fry over high heat until the ingredients are evenly coated, then serve.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gw22Gjk4LEI)

title: 泡面的 10 种做法
body:
## 做法

### 1. 牛肉丸泡面

1. 冷水中放入牛肉丸，无需解冻，煮至沸腾。
2. 加入泡面和粉包。
3. 面快熟时加入两条青菜，出锅前加入葱油包和生抽调味。

小贴士：牛肉丸煮出的汤汁可作为面汤。

### 2. 沙茶花生牛奶泡面

1. 锅中放 2 勺沙茶酱炒香。
2. 加入开水、1 小勺花生酱和半杯牛奶。
3. 放入泡面煮熟，粉包按口味少量加入。

小贴士：沙茶酱、花生酱和牛奶共同构成浓郁汤底。

### 3. 广式姜葱拌面

1. 碗中放姜丝和葱花，淋上热花生油。
2. 加入鸡味泡面调料粉，拌成酱汁。
3. 泡面煮熟沥水，与酱汁拌匀。剩余粉包可兑热水作汤。

小贴士：姜葱油在拌面前调好。

### 4. 鸡蛋羹泡面

1. 鸡蛋打散，倒入少量泡面汤拌匀。
2. 撇去泡沫，放入微波炉，低火加热 1 分 30 秒。
3. 淋少量芝麻油和酱油。

小贴士：加热效果随微波炉功率和蛋液用量变化，以蛋液凝固为准。

### 5. 煎蛋火腿香辣泡面

1. 锅中煎鸡蛋和火腿肠，煎至表面焦香。
2. 加水煮沸，放入泡面和调料包，煮熟即可。

小贴士：先煎后煮，让汤底带上煎蛋和火腿的香味。

### 6. 旋涡荷包蛋泡面

1. 水烧开，加入调料粉搅匀。
2. 转小火，搅出旋涡，打入鸡蛋。
3. 等鸡蛋中心定形，再下泡面煮熟。

小贴士：鸡蛋定形前不要急着翻动。

### 7. 咸蛋黄火腿汤泡面

1. 热锅加油，炒香姜片，放入咸蛋黄，炒至起沙。
2. 加入火腿肠、热水和泡面。
3. 可加入白菜、豆腐等配菜，煮熟即可。

小贴士：咸蛋黄本身有咸味，粉包酌量添加。

### 8. 皮蛋香菜泡面

1. 锅中炒香姜片、皮蛋和火腿肠末。
2. 加入开水和泡面粉包，放入泡面煮熟。
3. 最后撒入香菜。

小贴士：香菜在出锅前加入。

### 9. 咖喱土豆泡面

1. 土豆煎透，加入咖喱块炒香。
2. 倒入适量热水，放入泡面煮熟。

小贴士：咖喱块已有调味，可不加粉包。

### 10. 番茄炒泡面

1. 番茄去皮切碎。锅中炒香蒜末，加入番茄炒出汁。
2. 加入番茄泡面调味包和热水。
3. 加入鸡蛋和泡面，炒煮至熟。

小贴士：也可另配豆豉辣酱炒豆腐或腊肠。

## 参考链接

titleEn: Ten ways to upgrade instant noodles
description: 从清汤到拌面，换一种做法吃泡面。
descriptionEn: Ten variations, from brothy noodles to aromatic tossed noodles.
bodyEn:
## Method

### 1. Beef-ball noodle soup

1. Put frozen beef balls straight into cold water and bring to a boil.
2. Add the instant noodles and seasoning powder.
3. When the noodles are nearly cooked, add two leafy greens. Add the scallion oil sachet and light soy sauce before serving.

Tip: The beef-ball cooking liquid becomes the noodle broth.

### 2. Shacha, peanut and milk noodles

1. Fry 2 spoonfuls shacha sauce until fragrant.
2. Add boiling water, 1 small spoonful peanut butter and half a cup of milk.
3. Add the noodles and cook through. Add only a little seasoning powder to taste.

Tip: The shacha sauce, peanut butter and milk make a rich broth.

### 3. Cantonese ginger-scallion tossed noodles

1. Put shredded ginger and chopped scallions in a bowl and pour hot peanut oil over them.
2. Mix in chicken-flavored instant-noodle seasoning powder to make a sauce.
3. Cook and drain the noodles, then toss with the sauce. Any remaining seasoning powder can be dissolved in hot water for soup.

Tip: Prepare the ginger-scallion oil before tossing the noodles.

### 4. Egg custard with noodle broth

1. Beat the egg and mix in a little instant-noodle broth.
2. Skim off the bubbles and microwave on low power for 1 minute 30 seconds.
3. Drizzle with a little sesame oil and soy sauce.

Tip: Heating varies with microwave power and the amount of egg mixture; check that the egg has set.

### 5. Fried egg and ham spicy noodles

1. Pan-fry the egg and ham sausage until lightly browned and fragrant.
2. Add water and bring to a boil. Add the noodles and seasoning sachets and cook through.

Tip: Frying first adds egg and ham flavor to the broth.

### 6. Swirled poached-egg noodles

1. Bring water to a boil and stir in the seasoning powder.
2. Lower the heat, stir a vortex into the water and crack in the egg.
3. Wait for the center of the egg to set, then add the noodles and cook through.

Tip: Do not stir the egg before it has set.

### 7. Salted egg yolk and ham noodle soup

1. Heat oil, fry the ginger until fragrant, then add salted egg yolk and cook until grainy.
2. Add ham sausage, hot water and the noodles.
3. Add vegetables such as Chinese cabbage or tofu if desired and cook through.

Tip: Salted egg yolk is already salty; use the seasoning powder sparingly.

### 8. Century egg and cilantro noodles

1. Fry ginger, century egg and finely chopped ham sausage until fragrant.
2. Add boiling water and seasoning powder, then cook the noodles in the broth.
3. Scatter with cilantro at the end.

Tip: Add the cilantro just before serving.

### 9. Curry and potato noodles

1. Pan-fry the potatoes until cooked through, then add a curry block and fry until fragrant.
2. Add hot water and cook the noodles in the broth.

Tip: Curry blocks are already seasoned, so the powder sachet can be omitted.

### 10. Tomato stir-fried instant noodles

1. Peel and finely chop the tomatoes. Fry garlic until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and cook until juicy.
2. Add tomato-flavored noodle seasoning and hot water.
3. Add egg and noodles and cook, stirring, until done.

Tip: Serve with tofu or cured sausage stir-fried with fermented-black-bean chili sauce if desired.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m7adV4qL2KE)

title: 清蒸黄花鱼
body:
## 食材

- 黄花鱼 1 条
- 蒜 3～4 瓣：切末
- 葱、姜：切丝；小米椒 2～3 个：切粒
- 蒸鱼豉油 2 汤匙、料酒 1 茶匙
- 盐适量、热油 1～2 汤匙

## 做法

### 1. 处理鱼身

黄花鱼去鳞、内脏和鳃，洗净沥干，两侧每隔约半厘米划一刀。

### 2. 腌鱼

将蒜末和盐拌匀，抹在鱼身和刀口处，腌 20 分钟。

### 3. 准备蒸制

鱼身铺葱姜丝，淋料酒。另用小碗盛蒸鱼豉油，与鱼一起入锅。

### 4. 蒸鱼

水开后上锅，大火蒸 8 分钟，再转小火蒸 2～3 分钟。取出后去掉原来的葱姜。

### 5. 淋油调味

撒上新鲜葱姜丝和小米椒，淋热蒸鱼豉油，再浇八九成热的油。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/128601/)
description: 姜葱、蒸鱼豉油和热油，突出鱼肉的鲜味。
descriptionEn: Ginger, scallion, steamed-fish soy sauce and hot oil complement the fish.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 1 yellow croaker
- 3–4 garlic cloves, minced
- Scallions and ginger, shredded; 2–3 small hot chilies, finely diced
- 2 tablespoons steamed-fish soy sauce and 1 teaspoon cooking wine
- Salt to taste and 1–2 tablespoons hot oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the fish

Scale and gut the fish and remove the gills. Wash and drain. Score both sides at intervals of about half a centimeter.

### 2. Marinate

Mix the garlic and salt. Rub over the fish and into the cuts. Leave for 20 minutes.

### 3. Prepare to steam

Lay scallion and ginger over the fish and drizzle with cooking wine. Put the steamed-fish soy sauce in a small bowl and steam it alongside the fish.

### 4. Steam the fish

Once the water boils, steam over high heat for 8 minutes, then over low heat for another 2–3 minutes. Remove the fish and discard the used scallion and ginger.

### 5. Finish with hot oil

Add fresh shredded scallion, ginger and finely diced chili. Pour over the hot soy sauce, then drizzle with very hot oil.

## References

title: 凉拌折耳根
body:
## 食材

- 折耳根、蒜末、姜末、葱花
- 生抽、醋、香油、花椒油、油辣椒
- 盐适量

## 做法

### 1. 洗净折耳根

反复洗去泥沙，放冷水中浸泡 10 分钟，捞出沥干。

### 2. 准备配料

姜蒜切末，小葱切葱花。

### 3. 拌入料汁

折耳根放入大碗，加盐、姜末、蒜末、生抽、醋、香油、花椒油和油辣椒，充分拌匀。

### 4. 装盘

撒上葱花，即可食用。

descriptionEn: Crisp houttuynia roots tossed with ginger, garlic and a tangy, spicy dressing.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Houttuynia roots, minced garlic, minced ginger and chopped scallions
- Light soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, Sichuan pepper oil and chili oil with chili solids
- Salt to taste

## Method

### 1. Clean the roots

Wash repeatedly to remove dirt and grit. Soak in cold water for 10 minutes, then drain.

### 2. Prepare the aromatics

Mince the ginger and garlic and chop the scallions.

### 3. Toss with the dressing

Put the roots in a large bowl. Add salt, ginger, garlic, light soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, Sichuan pepper oil and chili oil with chili solids. Toss thoroughly.

### 4. Serve

Scatter over the scallions and serve.

title: 豆豉蒸排骨
body:
## 食材

- 猪肋排 500 克、土豆 1 个：切片
- 蒜末 2 勺、豆豉半勺
- 生抽 2 勺、蚝油 1 勺、生粉 1 勺
- 白糖、盐少许、食用油
- 面粉、水：清洗排骨用

## 做法

### 1. 清洗排骨

排骨加面粉和水，反复抓洗 2 分钟，再用清水冲净，沥干。

### 2. 调豆豉酱

蒜末和豆豉放碗中，淋热油激香，再加生抽、蚝油、白糖和盐拌匀。

### 3. 腌排骨

酱料倒入排骨，加生粉抓匀，腌约 30 分钟。

### 4. 铺盘

蒸盘底部铺土豆片，再均匀铺上排骨。

### 5. 蒸熟出锅

水开后入锅，大火蒸 25 分钟，蒸熟后取出。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/106804588/)
titleEn: Steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce
description: 排骨腌入豆豉蒜香，土豆铺底吸收肉汁。
descriptionEn: Black-bean garlic sauce seasons the ribs while potatoes catch the juices.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 500 g pork ribs; 1 potato, sliced
- 2 spoonfuls minced garlic and half a spoonful fermented black beans
- 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce, 1 spoonful oyster sauce and 1 spoonful starch
- A little sugar and salt; cooking oil
- Flour and water, for cleaning the ribs

## Method

### 1. Clean the ribs

Rub and wash the ribs with flour and water for 2 minutes. Rinse with clean water and drain.

### 2. Make the black-bean sauce

Put the garlic and black beans in a bowl. Pour hot oil over them to release their aroma, then mix in the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and salt.

### 3. Marinate the ribs

Add the sauce and starch to the ribs. Mix thoroughly and marinate for about 30 minutes.

### 4. Arrange on a plate

Line the steaming plate with potato slices and spread the ribs evenly over them.

### 5. Steam and serve

Once the water boils, steam over high heat for 25 minutes. Remove when cooked.

title: 菠菜炒鸡蛋
body:
## 食材

- 菠菜 1 把、鸡蛋 4 个
- 小葱适量：切末
- 盐半勺、食用油适量

## 做法

### 1. 焯菠菜

水烧开，加少许盐，放菠菜焯至翠绿。捞出过冷水，冷却后攥干，切段。

### 2. 备蛋液

鸡蛋打散，小葱切末。

### 3. 炒鸡蛋

热锅加油，油温八成热时倒入蛋液，炒熟后盛出。

### 4. 炒菠菜

原锅转小火，爆香葱花，加入菠菜炒至略出水。

### 5. 合炒调味

倒回鸡蛋，加盐，大火快速炒匀后出锅。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/106014471/)
description: 菠菜先焯水，鸡蛋单独炒熟，再合炒调味。
descriptionEn: Blanch spinach, cook the eggs separately, then toss them together.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 1 bunch spinach and 4 eggs
- Scallions to taste, minced
- Half a spoonful salt and cooking oil as needed

## Method

### 1. Blanch the spinach

Bring water to a boil with a little salt. Blanch the spinach until bright green, then transfer to cold water. Once cool, squeeze dry and cut into lengths.

### 2. Prepare the eggs

Beat the eggs and mince the scallions.

### 3. Scramble the eggs

Heat oil until very hot. Add the eggs, cook through and remove.

### 4. Fry the spinach

Turn the same pan to low heat. Fry the scallions until fragrant, then add the spinach and cook until it releases a little moisture.

### 5. Combine and season

Return the eggs, add salt and toss quickly over high heat, then serve.

## References

- [View recipe](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/106014471/)

title: 虾仁滑蛋
body:
## 食材

- 鸡蛋 4 个、虾仁 200 克
- 小葱适量：切葱花
- 料酒 2 茶匙、盐 1.5 茶匙（分两次使用）
- 淀粉 2 茶匙：加水调成水淀粉
- 食用油

## 做法

### 1. 腌虾仁

虾仁洗净擦干，加料酒 2 茶匙、盐 1 茶匙，腌制片刻。

### 2. 炒熟虾仁

热锅加油，虾仁大火快炒至变色、熟透，连同汤汁和油一起盛出放凉。

### 3. 调蛋液

鸡蛋加剩余的盐 0.5 茶匙打散，蛋白和蛋黄混合即可，不必过度搅打。

### 4. 拌入虾仁

将虾仁、汤汁、油和水淀粉倒入蛋液，拌匀。

### 5. 余温炒蛋

锅中多放些油，烧至冒烟后关火，倒入蛋液，用余温快速翻炒。边缘凝固时轻轻推散。

### 6. 出锅

蛋液刚好不流动时出锅，撒上葱花。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/103468406/)
description: 虾仁先炒熟放凉，再与蛋液混合，用余温炒出嫩滑口感。
descriptionEn: Cooked shrimp are folded into egg and gently scrambled using residual heat.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 4 eggs and 200 g shrimp
- Scallions to taste, finely chopped
- 2 teaspoons cooking wine and 1.5 teaspoons salt, divided
- 2 teaspoons starch, mixed with water into a slurry
- Cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Marinate the shrimp

Wash and dry the shrimp. Add 2 teaspoons cooking wine and 1 teaspoon salt, then marinate briefly.

### 2. Cook the shrimp

Heat oil and stir-fry the shrimp over high heat until they change color and are cooked through. Remove with their juices and oil and leave to cool.

### 3. Mix the eggs

Beat the eggs with the remaining 0.5 teaspoon salt just until the whites and yolks combine. Do not overbeat.

### 4. Combine with the shrimp

Mix the shrimp, juices, oil and starch slurry into the egg mixture.

### 5. Cook with residual heat

Use a generous amount of oil. Heat until it begins to smoke, turn off the heat, then add the egg mixture. Stir and fold quickly using the residual heat, gently breaking up the edges as they set.

### 6. Serve

Remove as soon as the egg mixture stops flowing. Scatter with scallions.

title: 蒜香孜然排骨
body:
## 食材

- 排骨适量、洋葱 1 个：切碎
- 蒜末、小米辣、葱段适量
- 姜、料酒：煮排骨用
- 辣椒粉、孜然粉、烧烤粉各适量
- 生抽 2 勺，盐、白糖少许
- 食用油

## 做法

### 1. 煮排骨

排骨加葱、姜和料酒，煮至八分熟，捞出沥干。

### 2. 炸排骨

锅中加油，放入排骨，炸至表面金黄酥香，捞出。

### 3. 炒香配料

锅留底油，放入蒜末、洋葱和小米辣炒香。

### 4. 加入香料

放入辣椒粉、孜然粉和烧烤粉，翻炒均匀。

### 5. 合炒调味

倒回排骨，加生抽 2 勺、少许盐和白糖，翻炒入味。

### 6. 出锅

放入葱段，快速炒匀后出锅。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/107245103/)
description: 排骨先煮后炸，再裹上蒜香与孜然调味。
descriptionEn: Parboiled, fried ribs are tossed with garlic and cumin seasoning.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Ribs as needed and 1 onion, finely chopped
- Minced garlic, small hot chilies and scallion lengths as needed
- Ginger and cooking wine, for boiling the ribs
- Chili powder, ground cumin and barbecue seasoning to taste
- 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce, a little salt and sugar
- Cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Boil the ribs

Boil the ribs with scallion, ginger and cooking wine until mostly cooked, then drain.

### 2. Fry the ribs

Heat oil and fry the ribs until golden and crisp on the outside, then remove.

### 3. Fry the aromatics

Leave a little oil in the pan. Fry the garlic, onion and chilies until fragrant.

### 4. Add the spices

Add chili powder, cumin and barbecue seasoning, then stir to combine.

### 5. Season the ribs

Return the ribs. Add 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce and a little salt and sugar, then toss until flavored.

### 6. Serve

Add the scallion lengths and toss quickly before serving.

title: 虾仁炒西兰花
body:
## 食材

- 西兰花、虾仁、蒜
- 酱油、生粉、鸡精、盐、食用油
- 小番茄、海南辣椒酱：可选

## 做法

### 1. 处理西兰花

西兰花洗净，用淡盐水浸泡 30 分钟，再洗净切小朵。

### 2. 腌虾仁

虾仁解冻、去虾线，加酱油和生粉，腌约 10 分钟。

### 3. 焯西兰花

沸水中加盐，放入西兰花焯至八成熟，捞出沥干。

### 4. 炒虾仁

蒜拍碎。热锅加少量油，炒香蒜末，加入虾仁炒至变色。

### 5. 合炒出锅

加入西兰花炒匀，加少许鸡精和盐调味，炒熟后出锅。

## 小贴士

- 可用小番茄点缀，按喜好搭配海南辣椒酱。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/100551182/)
description: 西兰花先焯水，再与蒜香虾仁快速合炒。
descriptionEn: Blanched broccoli is quickly stir-fried with garlicky shrimp.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Broccoli, shrimp and garlic
- Soy sauce, starch, chicken bouillon seasoning, salt and cooking oil
- Cherry tomatoes and Hainan chili sauce, optional

## Method

### 1. Prepare the broccoli

Wash the broccoli and soak in lightly salted water for 30 minutes. Rinse again and cut into florets.

### 2. Marinate the shrimp

Thaw and devein the shrimp. Mix with soy sauce and starch and leave for about 10 minutes.

### 3. Blanch the broccoli

Blanch the broccoli in salted boiling water until mostly cooked, then drain.

### 4. Stir-fry the shrimp

Crush the garlic. Heat a little oil, fry the garlic until fragrant, then add the shrimp and fry until they change color.

### 5. Combine and serve

Add the broccoli and stir-fry together. Season with a little chicken seasoning and salt, cook through and serve.

## Tips

- Garnish with cherry tomatoes and serve with Hainan chili sauce if desired.

## References

- [View recipe](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/100551182/)

title: 香煎银鳕鱼
body:
## 食材

- 银鳕鱼、黄油
- 小葱、生姜、蒜
- 蚝油、生抽、少量水

## 做法

### 1. 准备食材

小葱切段，姜蒜切片。银鳕鱼擦干水分，在鱼皮中间剪一刀，减少受热卷曲。

### 2. 煎鱼

热锅融化黄油，放入银鳕鱼，煎至两面金黄。

### 3. 加入酱汁

蚝油、生抽和少量水混合后倒入锅中，再加入葱段、姜片和蒜片。

### 4. 收汁出锅

小火煎至鱼肉熟透、汤汁收浓后装盘。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/104699264/)
description: 黄油煎香鱼肉，加入姜葱和酱汁，小火收浓。
descriptionEn: Butter-seared fish finished with ginger, scallion and a reduced sauce.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Yin xue yu fish and butter
- Scallions, ginger and garlic
- Oyster sauce, light soy sauce and a little water

## Method

### 1. Prepare the ingredients

Cut scallions into lengths and slice the ginger and garlic. Pat the fish dry and make a cut in the middle of the skin to reduce curling.

### 2. Sear the fish

Melt butter in a hot pan. Add the fish and sear until golden on both sides.

### 3. Add the sauce

Mix oyster sauce, light soy sauce and a little water and pour into the pan. Add the scallion, ginger and garlic.

### 4. Reduce and serve

Cook over low heat until the fish is cooked through and the sauce has reduced, then serve.

## References

- [View recipe](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/104699264/)

title: 万能料汁拍黄瓜
body:
## 食材

- 黄瓜、蒜、小米辣、香菜、熟芝麻、花生米
- 辣椒面 1 勺、热油 1 大勺
- 生抽 2 勺、蚝油 1 勺、陈醋 2 勺
- 盐半勺，白糖、香油少许

## 做法

### 1. 准备食材

黄瓜洗净拍碎，切小块。蒜切末，小米辣切圈，香菜切段。

### 2. 制作辣油

碗中放蒜末、小米辣、熟芝麻和辣椒面，淋入热油激香。

### 3. 调料汁

加入生抽、蚝油、陈醋、盐、白糖和香油，搅拌均匀。

### 4. 拌匀装盘

将料汁、香菜和花生米倒入黄瓜，充分拌匀即可。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/106918418/)
description: 热油激香蒜末与辣椒，再调成酸香料汁拌黄瓜。
descriptionEn: Hot oil releases the garlic and chili aroma before the cucumber is dressed.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Cucumber, garlic, small hot chilies, cilantro, toasted sesame seeds and peanuts
- 1 spoonful ground dried chili and 1 large spoonful hot oil
- 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce, 1 spoonful oyster sauce and 2 spoonfuls Chinese aged vinegar
- Half a spoonful salt, a little sugar and sesame oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the ingredients

Wash and smash the cucumber, then cut into chunks. Mince the garlic, slice the chilies and cut the cilantro into lengths.

### 2. Make the chili oil

Put the garlic, chilies, sesame seeds and ground dried chili in a bowl. Pour over hot oil to release the aroma.

### 3. Mix the dressing

Add the light soy sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, salt, sugar and sesame oil. Stir well.

### 4. Toss and serve

Add the dressing, cilantro and peanuts to the cucumber. Toss thoroughly and serve.

## References

- [View recipe](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/106918418/)

title: 椒丝腐乳炒空心菜
body:
## 食材

- 空心菜、蒜、红椒
- 腐乳、腐乳汁
- 糖 1 茶匙、盐 1 茶匙：焯水用
- 盐、生粉水、食用油、花生油

## 做法

### 1. 准备食材

空心菜洗净切段，蒜切末，红椒切丝。腐乳与腐乳汁捣成酱。

### 2. 焯空心菜

水烧开，加少许油、糖 1 茶匙和盐 1 茶匙，放入空心菜，焯至断生后捞出。

### 3. 炒香酱料

热锅加油，炒香蒜末、椒丝和腐乳酱。

### 4. 合炒出锅

放入空心菜，大火翻炒 1 分钟，加盐调味。淋少许生粉水勾芡，再加少许花生油炒匀出锅。

## 参考链接

- [查看做法](https://www.xiachufang.com/recipe/104413738/)
titleEn: Water spinach with fermented bean curd and chili
description: 腐乳捣成酱，配蒜蓉和椒丝，大火快炒。
descriptionEn: A quick high-heat stir-fry with fermented bean curd, garlic and pepper.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Water spinach, garlic and red pepper
- Fermented bean curd and its brine
- 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 teaspoon salt, for blanching
- Salt, starch slurry, cooking oil and peanut oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the ingredients

Wash and cut the water spinach into lengths. Mince the garlic and shred the pepper. Mash the fermented bean curd with its brine into a paste.

### 2. Blanch the greens

Bring water to a boil. Add a little oil, 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 teaspoon salt. Blanch the water spinach until just cooked, then drain.

### 3. Fry the sauce

Heat oil and fry the garlic, pepper and fermented bean curd paste until fragrant.

### 4. Stir-fry and serve

Add the water spinach and stir-fry over high heat for 1 minute. Season with salt, add a little starch slurry to thicken, then finish with a little peanut oil and toss before serving.
